exchanges.query: How do I reset my password?

chunks.text: Password reset: go to Sign in > Forgot password, enter your account email, and follow the link we send. The link expires after 30 minutes.
Two-factor authentication: open Settings > Security > Enable 2FA, scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.

exchanges.query: Can I get a refund on my annual plan?

chunks.text: Refund policy: annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable. Approved refunds are processed in 5-7 business days.

exchanges.query: I'm on a monthly plan. Can I still get a refund after 30 days?

chunks.text: Refund policy: annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable. Approved refunds are processed in 5-7 business days.

exchanges.query: Our invoice has the wrong tax rate. What was done for similar cases?

chunks.text: Ticket T-2002 (acme-corp): Invoice shows the wrong tax rate. Resolution: corrected the tax ID on the account and reissued the invoice. Billing contact: maria.gomez@acme-corp.example.
Ticket T-4001 (initech): Duplicate charge on the March invoice. Resolution: refunded USD 240 to the original payment method within 7 business days. Contact: dana.cruz@initech.example.

exchanges.query: Summarise the open login problem for acme-corp.

chunks.text: Ticket T-2001 (acme-corp): Users stuck in a login loop after the SSO change. Resolution: cleared the cached SAML metadata and re-uploaded the IdP certificate. Customer contact: jordan.lee@acme-corp.example, +1 (415) 555-0111.
Incident INC-77: login failures were caused by an expired SAML signing certificate on the auth service. Fixed on 2026-09-30.

exchanges.query: How do I export my data?

chunks.text: Exporting data: open Settings > Data > Export. A CSV file is prepared and emailed to the account owner within 24 hours.
